youtube.title: Why Is Your Chip Bag Mostly Air? 🥔 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The air in a chip bag is mostly nitrogen gas, pumped in just before the bag is sealed. It cushions the fragile chips so they do not break into crumbs. Nitrogen also pushes out oxygen, which would make the oil in the chips go stale.
